short_blurb: Kitchen & bath remodels, room additions, and new construction in South Gate.
local_note: Whether you're modernizing a kitchen, adding a primary suite, converting a garage, or building an ADU, Palm Crest Builders brings licensed, code-compliant construction to South Gate. As a Class B general building contractor we coordinate every trade under one contract and keep your project on schedule and on budget. We build throughout South Gate, including South Gate proper, Tweedy Mile, Hollydale, and nearby neighborhoods.

faqs.q: Do you pull building permits in South Gate?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle plans, plan check, and permits through the South Gate building and safety department for every remodel, addition, and ADU, and we schedule all required inspections.

faqs.q: Can I build an ADU in South Gate?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Under California and South Gate rules, most single-family lots qualify for a detached, attached, or garage-conversion ADU. We handle feasibility, design, permits, and construction.

faqs.q: How long will my South Gate remodel or addition take?
faqs.a: It depends on scope — bathrooms typically run 3–5 weeks, kitchens 4–8 weeks, and room additions 2–4 months. We give you a firm schedule with milestones in your written estimate.
